bills.title: Record a bill
bills.intro: Scan the member code the customer opens in the app, then type the bill number and the total printed on the paper bill.
bills.posSync: This store gives stamps and points from the bills synced from the POS, so there is nothing to record by hand. Use Record a customer at the till.
bills.scanRefused: Scanning is not allowed. Type the 6-digit code the customer opens in the app.
bills.scanUnreadable: That is not a member code. Scan again or type the 6-digit code.
bills.billNoHint: As printed on the bill, without spaces.
bills.totalHint: The total the customer paid, at the bottom of the bill.
bills.problem.code.empty: Scan or type the customer's member code.
bills.problem.code.format: A member code has exactly 6 digits.
bills.problem.billNo.format: A bill number has at most 40 characters and no spaces.
bills.problem.total.empty: Type the total from the bill.
bills.problem.total.format: A total has digits only, for example 185000 or 185.000.
bills.problem.total.zero: The total must be more than 0.
bills.error.invalid: The member code, bill number or total is not valid. Check them again.
bills.result.awaiting_customerBody: The customer types the total in the member app without seeing yours. Stamps and points are given when both match.
bills.result.confirmedBody: The bill is confirmed; the customer does not need to confirm it.
bills.result.queuedBody: The total is above the approval limit. Stamps and points are given once a manager approves.
bills.refusal.not_staff_mode: This store confirms from the bills synced from the POS; bills cannot be recorded by hand.
bills.refusal.locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again after {time}.
bills.refusal.lockedNoTime: Too many wrong codes. Try again in a few minutes.
bills.refusal.wrong_store: This code was made for another store. Ask the customer to choose this store in the app.
bills.refusal.code_unknown: The code is wrong. Ask the customer to open the code again, then scan or type it.
bills.refusal.code_expired: The code has expired. Ask the customer to open a new one.
bills.refusal.code_used: This code was already used. Ask the customer to open a new one.
bills.refusal.membership_inactive: This membership is suspended. Tell the store manager.
bills.refusal.no_programme: The membership programme is paused or has ended.
bills.refusal.staff_phone: A staff member's phone cannot earn stamps or points.
bills.refusal.over_bill_limit: The total is above the largest bill allowed. Tell a manager.
bills.refusal.bill_conflict: This bill number was recorded with another total. A manager has been told; check the bill again.
bills.refusal.bill_used: This bill is already recorded. No need to record it again.
bills.refusal.daily_limit: The customer has earned on the most bills allowed today.
bills.refusal.staff_shift_cap: You have recorded the most unconfirmed bills allowed today. Tell a manager.
bills.refusal.staff_amount_cap: The bills you recorded today reach the most allowed. Tell a manager.
bills.refusal.store_daily_cap: The store has recorded the most bills allowed today.
bills.refusal.below_minimum: The bill is below the minimum for a stamp or a point.
bills.refusal.other: The bill was not recorded. Try again.
bills.recentMine: Your bills of the last 24 hours
bills.reversal.disputed: The customer said it was wrong
bills.reversal.timed_out: The customer did not confirm in time
bills.reversal.manager_rejected: A manager did not approve it
bills.reverseRefusal.not_reversible: This bill can no longer be reversed.
bills.reverseRefusal.window_passed: The time to reverse has passed. Use an adjustment to correct it.
bills.reasonProblem.long: A reason has at most 200 characters.
counter.title: Counter code
counter.intro: Customers scan this code in the member app to send their bill. It changes on every refresh, so it only works at the counter.
counter.qrLabel: QR code for customers to send their bill
counter.refusal.not_available: This store does not let customers send bills with a counter code.
counter.refusal.no_store_code: The store has no store code for the customer app yet. Tell the owner.
counter.refusal.already_answered: Another staff member already answered this bill.
counter.claimsEmpty: No customer has sent a bill yet.
counter.claimsFailed: The waiting customers could not be loaded.
counter.blindHint: Read the total from the paper bill. The customer's total is not shown, so both readings stay independent.
billQueue.title: Review bills
billQueue.managersOnly: Only owners and managers review bills.
billQueue.refusal.own_bill: A manager cannot approve a bill they recorded. Ask the owner or another manager.
billQueue.refusal.not_queued: This bill has already been reviewed.
billQueue.done.failed: Recorded: failed. The bill has been reversed.
billQueue.auditRefusal.own_bill: A manager cannot pass a bill they recorded. Ask the owner or another manager.
redeem.staff.pendingBody: When the customer uses the reward, tap Confirm used, then apply the discount on the POS.
redeem.staff.apply: On the POS, choose the manual discount named:
redeem.staff.voidUntil: A manager can cancel it until {time} on {date}.
redeem.staff.voided: Reward cancelled. The stamps or points are back with the customer.
redeem.staff.refusal.not_staff_mode: This store confirms rewards from synced bills; no manual confirmation is needed.
redeem.staff.refusal.used: This reward is already confirmed as used.
redeem.staff.refusal.released: The reward has been given back to the customer.
redeem.staff.refusal.expired: The reward's hold has ended. The customer needs to redeem it again in the app.
redeem.staff.refusal.not_verified: Check the reward code before confirming it.
redeem.staff.refusal.same_staff: Whoever recorded a bill for this customer today cannot confirm their reward. Ask another staff member.
redeem.staff.refusal.staff_daily_cap: You have confirmed the most rewards allowed today. Ask another staff member.
redeem.staff.voidRefusal.not_staff_confi: This reward was not confirmed by staff, so it cannot be cancelled here.
redeem.staff.voidRefusal.window_passed: The time to cancel this reward has passed.
